assets.editPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer with strict identity preservation.
Asset: Companion native cast portrait, original fictional adult character. Produce exactly ONE edited full image, portrait 1122 x 1402 pixels requested, approximately 4:5, no UI, no lettering, no watermark.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: gate captain Yue Changning. Input 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: talisman maker Tang Zhu. Redraw Input 1 in the same beautiful, lavish romantic anime illustration family as Input 2, with emphatically clean anime cel rendering. Never copy Tang Zhu's identity, age, expression, costume, props or setting.
Preserve Yue's distinct adult identity: a 35-year-old East Asian woman with a broad mature face, pronounced cheekbones, warm brown complexion, heavy straight eyebrows, grey-brown almond eyes, direct reassuring gaze and faint confident closed-mouth smile. Preserve recognizable head silhouette, facial feature placement and mature proportions while translating them into clean anime line art. Keep her visibly adult, composed and strong.
Lock the exact source composition: dark swept-up hair in the same high compact bun and existing ornate gold bun band, same loose framing strands and small stud earrings; same crimson scarf folds and wrap, dark green lamellar ceremonial armor, every major gold relief shoulder guard/fastener, red tassel and plate arrangement; same stance, upper body angle and natural shoulder anatomy. Keep the palace gate setting with red doors and brass studs/knocker on viewer-right, courtyard tower at viewer-left, daylight through the gate, same warm direction of sunlight. Preserve source crop/headroom and torso framing, relative face size and all armor placement. Hands and weapons are outside the original composition: preserve that crop, do not add visible hands or draw a weapon.
Change the rendering, especially face/skin/lips: confident fine anime contour lines, smooth flat warm-brown local skin color, controlled two- or three-tone cel shadow shapes, illustrated eye contours and luminous anime irises, simplified elegant nose with minimal planar shading, delicate natural-color anime mouth line with understated lip fill. Maintain her face width, cheekbones, adult eyes and warm brown complexion; no whitening, infantilization or generic doll face. Use grouped inked hair strands and crisp illustrated highlights. Render armor as richly designed drawn green plates and gold ornament with broad deliberate shadow/highlight shapes; preserve lavish costume detail without photographic material noise. Render the same readable palace setting as a rich anime background.
Exclude photographic skin pores, skin grain, realistic wet or volumetric lips, glossy beauty portrait finish, photoreal face modeling, 3D render shading and doll faces. Do not redesign, change expression, enlarge eyes disproportionately, de-age, add jewelry/props/characters, reveal more skin, add bokeh/orbs/sparkles/lens blur, remove costume details, change pose, zoom, crop, add borders or text.
assets.visualComparison: High bun and gold band, dark brows, mature expression, warm brown face, crimson scarf, green/gold lamellar armor, red gate and courtyard remain recognizable. Skin shading is now drawn in broad cel planes; chin/jaw appear slightly sharper, and armor ornament is redrawn.
